content.short: AdaDomains is a Cardano naming system for .ada NFT domains, wallet records, and web identity tools today.
content.description: AdaDomains is a Cardano naming system designed as a decentralized alternative to traditional DNS. In its model, each domain is represented by NFTs that track both the name and its ownership, while associated records can resolve to Cardano wallet addresses, websites, social profiles, contact details, and other custom attributes. The project also supports subdomains and third-party integrations that want to use Cardano-based name resolution for identity and wallet discovery.
content.meta: AdaDomains provides .ada NFT domains and Cardano name resolution for wallets, websites, and identity. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
